name: The Gitrog
description: A giant, webbed, frog-like monster of Lake Zhava that drives people to sacrifice and swallows villagers whole with its tongue.

timeline.summary: The postal rider stops coming, and the rumor spreads that the Gitrog devoured the mail carrier.
timeline.quote: Within two days, accounts of the Gitrog devouring the mail carrier transformed from rumor to story to fact.

timeline.summary: Mia finds huge webbed prints and drag marks leading toward the lake and takes them for the Gitrog.
timeline.quote: The imprint looked like a large, webbed foot, with three talon-like divots at one end.

timeline.summary: The Gitrog surfaces beside the boat and Mia sees it for the first time.
timeline.quote: As the water settled, she saw it. The monster. The Gitrog.

timeline.summary: The Gitrog's tongue hurls Veryl off the ship and he disappears into the water.
timeline.quote: Veryl went flying backward off the ship, screaming through the air, and disappeared with a splash into the water.

timeline.summary: The Gitrog climbs aboard and devours Kalim just as he offers Mia in sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Mia watched in horror as Kalim's head disappeared into its gullet

timeline.summary: The Gitrog follows them ashore and Mia falls into its gaze, seeing what she takes for truth.
timeline.quote: She saw truth in its blackest form, the clarity of a thousand lifetimes compressed into one moment.

timeline.summary: Mia bows to the Gitrog, declaring all is sacrifice, and it eats Wilbur's body.
timeline.quote: a monstrous tongue lapped out, grasping the body of the broken boy beside her.

relations.note: It retreats to the lake after its attacks.
relations.quote: perhaps even catch sight of it before it slipped back into the lake

relations.note: It swallows him whole as he offers Mia.
relations.quote: Mia watched in horror as Kalim's head disappeared into its gullet

relations.note: Enthralled after its gaze, she hails it and offers sacrifice.
